an10.219:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā vyantībhāvaṃ vadāmi.
an10.219:1.2: tañce kho diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
an10.219:1.3: na tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā dukkhassantakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an10.219:2.1: sa kho so bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ …pe… tathā tatiyaṃ …pe… tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
an10.219:3.2: “pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ parittaṃ ahosi abhāvitaṃ. etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ. yaṃ kho pana kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati. na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī’ti.
an10.219:4.2: daharatagge ce so ayaṃ kumāro mettaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ bhāveyya, api nu kho pāpakammaṃ kareyyāti?
an10.219:5.1: akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ api nu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyāti?
an10.219:5.3: akarontaṃ hi bhante pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatī ti.
an10.219:6.1: bhāvetabbā kho panāyaṃ bhikkhave mettācetovimutti itthiyā vā bhikkhave purisena vā.
an10.219:6.2: itthiyā vā bhikkhave purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāya gamanīyo.
an10.219:6.5: “yaṃ kho me idha kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ idha vedanīyaṃ,
an10.219:6.7: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave mettācetovimutti anāgāmitāya saṃvattati, idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
an10.219:7.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthaṃ -
an10.219:7.4: iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
an10.219:8.2: “pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ parittaṃ ahosi abhāvitaṃ, etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ. yaṃ kho pana me kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī”ti.
an10.219:9.2: daharatagge ce so ayaṃ kumāro upekkhaṃ cetovimuttiṃ bhāveyya, api nu kho pāpakammaṃ kareyyāti?
an10.219:10.1: akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ api nu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyāti?
an10.219:10.3: akarontaṃ hi bhante pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatī ti.
an10.219:11.1: bhāvetabbā kho panāyaṃ bhikkhave upekkhā cetovimutti itthiyā vā purisena vā.
an10.219:11.2: itthiyā vā bhikkhave purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāya gamanīyo.
an10.219:11.5: “yaṃ kho me idha kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ idha vedaniyaṃ.
